item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi rgyud las g.yung drung ga'u tshe yi bsgrubs pa
item.coloph: lha klu mi gsum snang mdog nas/ gdung rabs rim par brgyud de/ mkhas pa mi bzhi nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud do/ de nas stang chen dmu tsha gyer med la gnyer gtad de/ byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la bsgrub (sgrub) pa bsnyems pas tshe yi rig 'dzin thob pa'o/ 'chi med tshe yi bsgrub (sgrub) pa/ u ya/ smar ro/ stag la me 'bar gyis lung bstan bka' rgya yod/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyi snyan du brgyad pa'o//
